name: Shadow AI
short_description: AI tools and agents that employees install or sign up for on their own, running outside the view and control of the IT team.

evidence.quote: There's a darker version too often called shadow AI.
Somewhere inside your M365 tenant, shadow agents are running.
This is shadow AI. It isn't malicious.
Shadow AI discovery. Your employees are probably using AI tools at work.
Shadow AI happens when employees build their own AI systems without any formal approval
that is called like, you know, shadow, IT or shadow, AI
unmanaged shadow AI tools just to get their jobs done
we are seeing a massive surge in shadow AI as a result
